blocks.text: Adult circumcision is a surgical procedure that involves the removal of the foreskin from the penis for medical, hygiene, cosmetic, or personal reasons. The procedure is typically completed within about an hour and may be performed using local or general anesthesia depending on the patient’s needs and the surgeon’s recommendation.

sections.heading: Ready to take the next step?

blocks.text: Please reach us at info@tampabaybodysculpting.com if you cannot find an answer to your question.

Healthy adult men seeking circumcision for medical, cosmetic, hygiene, or personal reasons may be candidates for the procedure. A consultation is recommended to determine the best treatment plan for your needs.
Men may choose adult circumcision for medical, hygiene, cosmetic, religious, or personal reasons. Some patients also seek the procedure to address discomfort, tight foreskin, or recurring irritation.

Most patients experience mild swelling and discomfort during the first several days after surgery. Light activities can usually be resumed within a few days, while full healing generally occurs over several weeks.
